messages.subject: Sample Size plot
parts:
Hi everyone, can someone give me an easy way to interpret the sample size plot, everything makes sense except the the cv. Is the cv taken from the experimental data or is this the cv needed to detect a fold change at a certain number of replicates. I assume the cv is taken from the data, but I don't know how to interpret the top of the plot

Cheers

Brett

messages.author: 085b00b73e467d88
messages.subject: Re: Sample Size plot
parts:
Hi Brett,

Sample size calculation is an interplay between factors including power, fold change, and false discovery rate (FDR). The sample size plot shows the required sample size for the desired FC, based on the biological and technical variance estimates obtained from the model fitted on the current dataset as well as pre-specified power and FDR. 

The CV in the plot corresponds to the desired FC, with associated uncertainty characterized by the variances (from the currently analyzed dataset) and the calculated sample size. 

Hope this helps
Tsung-Heng
